name: eval_import_provenance
sql: CREATE TABLE "eval_import_provenance" ( "installation_id" varchar(128) COLLATE BINARY NOT NULL, "tenant_id" varchar(128) COLLATE BINARY NOT NULL, "creator_principal_id" varchar(128) COLLATE BINARY NOT NULL, "snapshot_key" varchar(64) COLLATE BINARY NOT NULL, "manifest_sha256" varchar(64) COLLATE BINARY NOT NULL, "provenance_digest" varchar(64) COLLATE BINARY NOT NULL, "provenance_json" text NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("snapshot_key") )

name: eval_results

name: requests
sql: CREATE TABLE "requests" ( "request_id" varchar NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY, "user_id" varchar NOT NULL, "api_key_id" varchar NOT NULL, "model_id" varchar NOT NULL, "provider_id" varchar NOT NULL, "prompt_tokens" bigint NOT NULL, "completion_tokens" bigint NOT NULL, "reasoning_tokens" bigint NOT NULL, "cache_read_tokens" bigint NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "cache_write_tokens" bigint NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "estimated_charge_micro_usd" bigint NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "streamed" integer NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "latency_ms" bigint NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "generation_time_ms" bigint NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "error" varchar, "created_at" varchar NOT NULL , "uncached_input_tokens" bigint NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "output_tokens" bigint NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "usage_origin" varchar NOT NULL DEFAULT 'unknown', "raw_usage_json" text, "charge_status" varchar NOT NULL DEFAULT 'legacy_unknown', "charge_evidence_json" text, "reconciliation_status" varchar NOT NULL DEFAULT 'not_applicable', "reconciliation_attempts" integer NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "reconciliation_last_error" text, "reconciliation_last_attempt_at" varchar, "authoritative_settled_at" varchar, "authoritative_receipt_json" text, "launch_id" varchar, "agent_harness" varchar, "controller_instance_id" varchar, "acp_session_id" varchar, "native_root_session_id" varchar, "native_agent_thread_id" varchar, "native_parent_agent_thread_id" varchar, "native_turn_id" varchar, "route_lease_id" varchar, "session_identity_json" text, "route_scope_id" varchar, "router_id" varchar, "binding_digest" varchar, "original_selector" varchar)

name: tenancy_tenants
